text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Relying on her experience to pinpoint the 
perfect moment to make her move, Ikuno 
Dictus brilliantly claimed victory in the 
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, they praised each other's 
good fight alongside Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Yasuda Kinen. Ikuno 
Dictus's fatigue was lower than 
anticipated. The Trainer feels her 
undeniable growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And next up is finally the Takarazuka 
Kinen. The grand finale of the Senior Year 
spring goals.
